text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista got injured. I rushed her to 
the nurse's office right away.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry. If only I had focused 
more..."
choice_data_list:
It wasn't you... It's all my 
responsibility.

It's not your fault... It's all my 
responsibility

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: No, that can't be...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If only I had watched her more closely... 
Regret consumes my mind."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...I know it's reckless. Still...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Could you please let me continue training?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Checking my form, muscle training... There 
are still so many things I need to do.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Besides... I don't want to look at that 
face of yours any longer.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"I want to keep moving forward, even if 
it's bit by bit. So... please!"
choice_data_list: ...Even so, you need to rest right now.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"I want to keep moving forward, even if 
it's bit by bit. So... please!"
choice_data_list: ...Even so, you need to rest right now.
...Even so, you need to rest right now.
Got it... Let's find what we can do!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: But...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista saw right through my regrets. 
It's pathetic of me... but there's no way 
I could let her push herself recklessly 
for my sake.
choice_data_list:
I don't want the road to that promise... 
to be shut.

I don't want the path to our promise... to 
be closed off.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
choice_data_list: So... let's take the day off, Buena.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry. You're right. After all, we 
came all this way aiming for that very 
scenery."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for stopping me. Right now, I'll 
focus on recovering.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Yes, thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
The pain is gradually getting worse... 
.........Ghh!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry. I guess that really was 
reckless after all."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
So I can return as soon as possible... I 
will stay quiet and rest for a while.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems the injury has worsened. Let's 
focus on resting now to aim for a full 
recovery.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Phew. At this pace, it doesn't look 
like it'll hurt.
choice_data_list:
Let's get the menu sorted out and keep at 
it.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Even if it's step by step... let's 
keep moving forward together again.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista earnestly tackled what she 
could do right now, steadily making her 
comeback.
